title: Bazel CI: RuntimeException with rules_go

labels.name: P1
labels.description: I'll work on this now. (Assignee required)

body:
### Description of the problem / feature request:

Bazel CI: Bazel (with downstream projects) pipeline is failing in the rules_go job (using Bazel from HEAD).

I can repro this locally, and bisected the culprit to be 45b308a62f42c2c0bcfe79dcd4046c4025a31059.

### Bugs: what's the simplest, easiest way to reproduce this bug? Please provide a minimal example if possible.

1. Build Bazel from https://github.com/bazelbuild/bazel/commit/45b308a62f42c2c0bcfe79dcd4046c4025a31059
2. Clone rules_go from https://github.com/bazelbuild/rules_go/commit/d850f8bbd15d94ce11a078b3933e92ebbf09f715
3. Use the custom Bazel in rules_go to build:

```
  $ ~/stuff/bazel/bazel-bin/src/bazel clean --expunge  ; ~/stuff/bazel/bazel-bin/src/bazel build --keep_going --announce_rc ...
```
